newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine state firms owe banks 577 mln hryvnias.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine state firms owe banks 577 mln hryvnias.

text.p: Ukraine's state-owned businesses owe 577 million hryvnias, including interest, to commercial banks which extended credits under government guarantees, the chairman of the central bank said on Thursday.
"The debt, both short-term and long-term, totals 422 million hryvnias without interest and 577 million hryvnias counting the interest," Viktor Yushchenko told a news conference.
The debt accounts for about half of loans issued by Ukrainian commercial banks, he added.
Yushchenko, speaking after a bankers' meeting this week with President Leonid Kuchma, said Ukraine was considering issuing Treasury bills to cover the debt.
He said such bills might be issued by the end of the year but did not disclose an amount or possible maturity.
